purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 103 after preserving and auditing the untouched v84 baseline.
change_scope: One generic recovery change: when desktop.open_path reports a missing path, return bounded exact-basename file or directory candidates from the guest home tree and require the model to explicitly retry. Never rewrite or execute the retry automatically.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The model repeatedly selected the correct desktop.open_path action but inferred home-root paths for a workbook stored on Desktop. It never chose filesystem.find, and the downstream missing-path error exposed no exact candidate. The no-progress window stopped the Agent loop after 55.579 seconds; evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use unrelated Workshop Notes documents in two synthetic directories plus a case-mismatched distractor. They require exact basename matching, bounded traversal, unchanged forwarding of the first model call, an explicit model retry, and no automatic candidate execution.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The failed call is executed exactly as emitted by the model. Recovery returns candidate paths and retry_options only; the model must select and emit the next desktop.open_path call itself.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; no action or schema was added
implementation_evidence.ruff: changed active source and tests passed lint and format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit the untouched baseline, classify the failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most three materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three fail, mark the task task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry.

selection.method: first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
